gen-gf-fondamento-plus-jakarta-sans: Plus Jakarta Sans reads modern and precise, drawn like bent wire. Fondamento sits above it with loose, handwritten grace, and if that heading shrinks too small, its relaxed charm gets lost against the plain sans.
gen-gf-fondamento-sora: Sora draws its curves with no pressure swell at the corners, keeping a geometric precision that stays widely parted in the c and s. Fondamento adds relaxed, handwritten grace above.
gen-gf-fondamento-space-grotesk: Fondamento writes like a loose pen on paper, graceful and relaxed, with c tips that stay clear of touching. Space Grotesk keeps a constant-width line like a fineliner, which makes it the better partner for brief copy.
gen-gf-fontdiner-swanky-fs-rowan: Commanding and distinctive, Fontdiner Swanky spaces its letters generously and hides a light modulation you only spot up close. Rowan is the literary, friendly counterpart, so give it a modest size and it stays comfortable.
gen-gf-frijole-fs-paquito: Expressive and loud, Frijole stretches every word with wide intervals while its curves pinch almost shut. Paquito follows with confident, approachable letters whose capitals barely rise above the lowercase, so longer reading stays comfortable.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-bhutuka-expande: Spaghetti-thin lines, all one width, with tall lowercase in Funnel Display. And BhuTuka Expanded One, authoritative and literary, slows the pace to a leisurely walk, its curvy letters feeling unclamped over a longer read.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-hepta-slab: Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like strokes of one width, expressive and commanding, with capitals barely taller than the lowercase. Hepta Slab brings a bookish, dignified stretch to every word, and its bent-paperclip lines make that dignity the pair's best quality.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-kiwi-maru: Kiwi Maru spaces its letters generously, with terminals that stop far from the stem and a ring-like o. Against Funnel Display's spaghetti lines, that editorial looseness is the pair's best quality.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-padyakke-expand: Spaghetti-like strokes of one width give Funnel Display its expressive, commanding look. Padyakke Expanded One sits beside it like knots on a slack rope, wide-mouthed and authoritative, so the two feel stretched and stately together.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-stint-ultra-exp: Funnel Display excels at expressive, commanding headlines built from spaghetti-like strokes that never crowd their c tips. Stint Ultra Expanded does the quieter work, each pipe-cleaner letter floating apart.
